snippet.title: The Last Transmission | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3684440/The_Last_Transmission
Subscribe for Broadcasts from Station 23: https://transmission-feed-d4156e.beehiiv.com/subscribe
Follow on Twitter/X: https://x.com/LimitedInStudio

The Last Transmission is a psychological horror game built on dread, isolation, and the creeping feeling that something is watching you.
No combat. No escape. Just you, your tools—and the sound of something moving through the static.

Press Kit:
https://impress.games/press-kit/hidden-veil-studios/the-last-transmission
